candidates.name: Phaser 3.90.0

webLite.evidence: The existing workspace already pins Phaser 3.90.0 and produces a self-contained browser QA build; official release evidence: https://github.com/phaserjs/phaser/releases/tag/v3.90.0

wechatMiniGame.evidence: No validated Phaser 3 export adapter was found. The official archived minigame-adaptor is Unity-oriented rather than a Phaser runtime adapter: https://github.com/wechat-miniprogram/minigame-adaptor

douyinMiniGame.evidence: Official engine guidance lists Unity, Cocos, Godot, Laya and Egret but provides no verified Phaser adapter: https://developer.open-douyin.com/docs/resource/zh-CN/mini-game/develop/guide/game-engine/engine-adaptation-instructions

tapTapMiniGame.evidence: TapTap Mini Game has no BOM or DOM and requires an engine-specific adapter; official guidance documents Unity, Cocos, Laya and Egret but not Phaser: https://developer.taptap.cn/minigameapidoc/dev/tutorial/overview/

attributionDuties: Retain the Phaser MIT copyright and permission notice in distributions containing substantial portions of the library.
approvedScope: Existing web-lite development renderer and browser QA build only.
candidates.rationale: Continue using the already-installed, license-verified renderer for the current browser prototype. This decision does not approve any mini-game platform package.

douyinMiniGame.evidence: No validated repository adapter or real-device evidence in this run proves three.js r185 works as a Douyin Mini Game package. Approval is limited to web-lite QA.

tapTapMiniGame.evidence: No validated repository adapter or real-device evidence in this run proves three.js r185 works as a TapTap Mini Game package. Approval is limited to web-lite QA.

candidates.rationale: Use the small, renderer-only dependency to test the user-approved oblique 3D camera, solid thickness and visible cut caps without replacing the deterministic gameplay simulation.

approvedCandidateNames: Quaternius Ultimate Stylized Nature Pack May 2022
conclusion.architectureDecision: Keep Phaser 3.90.0 and the existing deterministic simulation untouched for the original web-lite prototype. Use the isolated three.js r185 web-lite POC with build-time DefinitelyTyped declarations, hash-verified Kenney CC0 GLB background props and one hash-verified OpenGameArt CC0 GLB blade selected by browser inspection. Keep cuttable geometry and visible cut caps original, and layer non-simulating trail, flash, particles, brief hit-stop and camera trauma onto the cut event. Do not claim WeChat, Douyin or TapTap Mini Game publishability; each platform still requires an isolated adapter spike, platform-specific tests and real-device evidence.
